notes.title: Give old sports facilities a second life! Sports: Renovations announced
notes.notes:
What happens when a sports game meets a house renovator? A game where you renovate old sports facilities! 

Restore the glory of sports in a [b]relaxing renovator sim[/b], made by Goat Gamez, a studio founded by Movie Games and [b]Robert Lewandowski[/b]!

Wishlist the game now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

How do you save your beloved team’s court from being torn down by a real estate developer? You do what you do best – renovate dilapidated sports facilities to collect the money you need to help out.

Restore gyms, courts, pools and pitches to their former glory, upgrade your tools and expand your headquarters. Collect trophies and mementoes during your renovation missions and display them proudly in a special room for everyone to see.

[b]FEATURES:[/b]

[list][*]Two game modes: Campaign with a predefined number of levels and storyline.
[*]Buy new tools and upgrade the equipment you already own.
[*]Earn money on your renovation jobs and use it to expand your own base of operations – each room unlocked will add some perks and some of the rooms come with a side mission.
[*]Buy cosmetic items you can place around your office.
[*]Trophy room where the player sees various memorabilia collected during renovation missions.[/list]

Are you ready to give sports facilities a second chance?

notes.title: The Mega Patch is Live Now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/ff8e64091926fea32cbf95518d3b1a5cd96d2ca3.png[/img]
[b]Hello Treasure Hunters,[/b]
 
We just released our first [b]content patch[/b] for [b]Treasure Hunter Simulator[/b]. This patch introduces many new things, improvements, changes and bug fixes that you requested in your reviews and forum comments. In fact, the new update is so big, we decided to call it [b]MEGA PATCH!!![/b] [i][u](dum, dum dum!)[/u][/i]
 
Please keep in mind that due to the number of balance and gameplay changes you will [b]need to start a new game[/b]. We apologize for this inconvenience.
 
Our aim in this patch was to make [b]Treasure Hunter Simulator[/b] a game that focuses on completion and finding all the treasures instead of having an endless supply of bullet shells. [b]We continue to implement changes and improvements to the game[/b], and this is the [b]first large step[/b] to bring it more into the direction we should have taken at release.

Check out the full list of changes down below. Please let us know what you are thinking about our game in the current state. It would be awesome if you could go back to your [b]Steam review[/b] and update it accordingly ːsteamhappyː

[h1][b]CONTENT PATCH[/b][/h1]
 
[h1]GAME FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]We’ve added lots of new treasures scattered over all locations for you to find.
[*]The locations you visit now randomize their treasures only once when you enter them for the first time. This allows for location completions and clearing them completely instead of having your progress reset every time you visit. This change does not affect the Exploration Mode.
[*]Collection displays have been added to the office. These medium and small wooden boxes are created to hold specific sets of items. Once you find an item that fits into a collection, it will be automatically added there. Try to complete all the sets.
[*]The identification system has been completely reworked. After spraying a treasure to clean it up, you need to recognize it by finding unique details on the item. This process becomes easier the more items of the same type you find.
[*]The Exploration Mode is now available right away and no longer requires you to finish the Story Mode. This change has been made to allow the less hardcore treasure hunters to enjoy the game at their own pace without worrying about any storylines.
[*]The office has been expanded. Now you can move freely to admire your collections in the new displays. 
[*]The displays in the office will show placeholders until you can replace them with a treasure you find. You can pick up one of those placeholders to get information in which locations you should look for that particular treasure.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/8ce1cdf79635c3dd6fd06762ecd9282b26bfbd1f.jpg[/img]
[h1]BALANCE CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]The prices of treasures have been increased to more closely reflect their value in the real world. Keep in mind that while the value of some treasures has now been greatly increased, it will still be worth a lot less than in the real world. It would be just impossible to balance the game with a treasure worth 100,000$ or sometimes, even more, so we sacrifice some realism for game balancing.
[*]The prices for travelling to distant locations and buying detectors have been increased to fit with the new balance changes.
[*]All jobs you accept now offer money as an additional reward to the prestige they offered so far. We felt that the main jobs should at least help cover the expenses. The gains from jobs increase significantly with your progress.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/e2e70db4b08061bb266523985777a67a515b0433.jpg[/img]
[h1]OTHER CHANGES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Treasures are now divided across locations in a much more thought out way.
[*]The jobs and collections interface has been fully redesigned to be easier to understand and navigate.
[*]Steam Cloud saving has been added to the game. It can be enabled via the new in-game “Other” options category.
[*]The performance of all the maps has been greatly improved even on low-end setups.
[*]The number of clicks needed to dig up an item has been decreased.
[*]The treasure position in dug up holes has been improved, and now all items should be visible.
[*]Treasures that have not yet been cleaned are covered with a lot more dirt.
[*]The office and the main menu have been combined for a better experience and to reduce the number of loading screens.
[*]The main menu camera settings have been readjusted to fit the new office.
[*]New walking animations have been added to fit the office movement.
[*]New hints have been added to the office map to explain office movement and collections.
[*]The identification hint has been expanded to explain the new changes.
[*]Each map can now be reset to force respawning of all treasures in new and different spots. This will reset your current progress on the map.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/33f4cf55478e51d4166021d7b1f907ec8bb9d7b5.jpg[/img]
[h1]MAP OPTIMIZATIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Multiple world assets now have a better level of details (LODs).
[*]Created hierarchical LODs for the first level of detail.
[*]Multiple clusters of static objects have been merged into one.
[*]Added missing culling for foliage and disabled the shadows on some of them as they just ate up performance without contributing much visually.
[*]Added distance culling for various objects.
[*]Removed some parts of the terrain that was never visible.
[*]Scaled down the unnecessary complexity of some objects (wireframe density).
[*]Disabled the tessellation of multiple objects that didn’t add anything in terms of visual quality.
[*]Enabled density scaling for several foliages.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/afb05bac6b42a9f0f9f41cceee4bcac0d242d39a.jpg[/img]
[h1]BUGS[/h1]
[list]
[*]Digging should be more reliable now. We changed the method of how items are detected and processed to get rid of multiple problems. It should also greatly help with the “You can’t dig here” issue.
[*]Picture detection has been completely reworked which should resolve the problem with being unable to take certain pictures. 
[*]All items now face the correct way when starting the identification process.
[*]Several translation issues have been corrected.
[*]All treasures now have correctly scaled icons and backgrounds added to them.
[*]Fixed an issue where the PDA could become invisible in the Oman Oasis map.
[*]Several issues connected to the treasure randomization have been corrected.
[*]The detector movement animations and camera placement have been improved.
[*]Multiple “under the hood” code optimizations connected to the player movement, treasure placement and randomization, trash spawning and the save and load system.
[/list]

[b]Have fun,[/b]
[i]Doctor Jones[/i]

notes.title: The Big Patch: Identification
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/91411a182bfd00477ef577f43286f7f433b6174d.jpg[/img]
Identification of treasures is a big part of the Treasure Hunter Simulator gameplay and right now it’s the least engaging part of the game. Pressing one button whenever you dig out something felt tedious and out of place for a game that’s based on finding precious items.
 
To improve the overall feeling when finding an item and making it more engaging, we decided to increase the number of actions required to learn what an item actually is.
 
After picking up an item your first step will be to get all the dust and mud off of it using your trusted air can. This step is well known to anyone that played Treasure Hunter Simulator up to this point and it remains mostly unchanged.
 
The next step is something we added based on what we feel is the most interesting part of any treasure finding. After the dirt is gone you will need to look closely at the item and try to find parts of it that would make it easier to recognize what the object is. Through careful observation you will slowly increase your knowledge of the treasure and eventually be able to tell exactly what it is. Rotate it, view it from different angles and have a closer look.
 
The treasures differ in size and complexity, so some might require you to find more interesting points than others, but the entire process is completed by looking at an item from as many angles as possible.
 
However, since our character is a well-known and experienced treasure hunter, he won’t forget what he just saw. For every item that fits the same description the identification process will become easier requiring you to find less and less details in order to correctly identify the treasure.
 
We feel that this change will make the entire process a lot more engaging and a bit closer to the reality of treasure hunting.

notes.title: The Big Patch: Economy Preview
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/f4a3cf373956fa26d1616ce61c019f84525d1f41.jpg[/img]
The value of things you find and costs of traveling to locations multiple times has been an issue for many players, especially when they didn’t get lucky before the earlier patches and an item they needed might not have spawned when they travelled to the location.

To address these issues and many more, the next patch will change some of the basic aspects of how items are spawned and how much they are worth.

The first major change is how we generate what you can find in each location. Currently, all items are generated every time you enter a location. With the upcoming patch, they will only be generated when you enter the location for the first time. Every other time you travel to that location, you will be able to continue searching and digging. This change becomes especially important when your metal detector is limiting you in finding all items until you get a better one.

As we set up the dig sites only once now, this patch will also improve how items are distributed across locations to address another complain: for items to be more location specific. On top of the changes how we distribute them, the patch also adds many new items to find.

Currently, the pricing begins at $1 for trash items and goes up to about $50 for the really interesting ones. The upcoming patch will also change that aspect of game by completely revamping the pricing. While trash items remain at the low value, the more interesting items now go up in value up to several hundred dollars. 
Yes, many of them are worth a lot more in real life, but that is a sacrifice of realism we have to make for the sake of balancing. Otherwise finding a single item worth ten thousands of dollars would basically make the entire economy aspect of the game obsolete.

We also altered the travel expenses to be more realistic, but increased the prices for better metal detectors to balance the in-game economy better. This however was not a zero-sum approach, just another step to make pricing more realistic. These price increases are easily offset by how much more items will be worth. 
Additionally, each job you take for a location now will also have a cash reward on top of the prestige reward it had so far. Combined these measures should pretty much eliminate the need for grinding for cash if you don’t waste money going to locations every couple of finds instead of staying there for a bit longer. 
Since we do not randomize the items every time you get to a location anymore, you will now also get a nice progress for each location showing you how many items you have found there and how much is still left to be discovered.

All these changes are great and address a lot of issues the community voiced, but where does it leave the Exploration Mode? While the overall changes such as new items and pricing still apply, the Exploration Mode retains its randomization of items every time you enter a location. However, the Exploration Mode will now stand on its own and can be played right away without the need to finish the Story Mode first.

notes.title: A Big Patch is Coming!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31321039/e2e70db4b08061bb266523985777a67a515b0433.jpg[/img]

In February we will release a massive patch for Treasure Hunter Simulator that will address the majority of issues the community has voiced so far and also alter some of the design choices based on suggestions from the playerbase. 

This patch is something to look forward to no matter if you already like the game or not. If you like it, you will most definitely like it even more. And if you had complains about the game, that patch might very well convince you to have another look at the game.

Here a quick rundown of some of the changes in the upcoming patch. 
[list]
[*] Items and treasures will be randomized only once when you enter the map and remain static throughout your play-through. The Exploration Mode remains unaffected and will still randomize on each entry, but the Exploration Mode will no longer require to complete the Story Mode.
[*] A lot more items and treasures have been added to all locations and the items you find are now more location specific.
[*] All prices have been rebalanced and made more realistic. In general rarer items yield a lot more money now while the trash remains at 1 or 2 dollars. New metal detectors and travelling costs have been increased for balancing purposes.
[*] Jobs now also reward money on top of prestige with the purpose to cover most of the travelling costs to the location they send you to. Combined with more money from the items you find this will counter the need to grind for money.
[*] Rather than turning digging into more of a mini game as initially plant, we felt that the identification of items is a way more important component. Identifying items has now been redesigned and is a sort of mini game in itself rather than just pressing a button.
[*] The office size has been increased, displays and display cases have been added allowing you to showcase your rarer items and group them into small expositions (like rare coins). You can also move freely around the office now.
[*] The job UI has received an overhaul and is now simpler to navigate.
[*] Performance on various specs has been significantly improved. All locations also underwent performance improvements.
[*] Lots of bug fixes and smaller improvements.
[/list]

The patch will also come with lots of bug fixes and smaller improvements and even a reduction in loading screens. We will post more about details concerning changes to single systems and additional changes not yet included in the above list starting next week. For now we just wanted to let you know what we are up to and what you can expect from the next patch.

notes.title: Hot Fix #1
notes.notes:
We just released a small patch to apply fixes for the following issues:

Bavarian Lake is no longer dark. The “night problem” has been fixed and the map will now display correctly with a nice late afternoon setting.

Achievements are now being correctly registered. When you find the next legendary item or finish the next job, the appropriate Steam achievements will trigger correctly.

Treasure Hunter Simulator will no longer trigger VR on game start.

The base screen resolution is now being set to 1024x768 on first launch which should allow all those who has issues with a wrong resolution setting to set their resolution manually.

We are now working on further bug fixes and improvements with another patch planned toward the end of the week.

notes.title: We need your support + some launch afterthoughts
notes.notes:
Dear Treasure Hunters,

[b]We wanted to thank each of you for playing our game [/b]and for all the comments you leave on the Discussion boards and under your reviews. All of them have been read carefully, we are writing down every piece of feedback you share with us. [b]Some changes have already been made yesterday[/b], but this is just a beginning.

If you have anything to say about how we can improve the game, please write it in the comments section below. It doesn’t matter if you did it already somewhere else or somebody posted it in an earlier comment. Each voice counts and we will be able to focus on the things that matter to the majority if they are gathered in one place. So far we have three threads about [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/748300/discussions/0/1745605598709176831/]resolution[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/748300/discussions/0/1745605598709183654/]mouse clicking [/url]and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/748300/discussions/0/1745605598709171335/]Night Map[/url]. Please go there if you’re seeking a solution for one of those.

Aware of the flaws, [b]we aim to improve the game and provide you with the best experience[/b]. That’s why the reviews are so important for us. First of all, they bring us a lot of constructive feedback. Secondly, Treasure Hunter Simulator has reached “Mixed” review status. That makes our organic reach on Steam dropping dramatically and we would be able to reach many more players if we reached the “Positive” status. If you like the game, please spare a couple of minutes to write a review. If you don’t like something in our game but still enjoy it, give us a chance to make it better and switch your review into positive. [b]That would mean A WORLD to us![/b]

Of course, we fully understand if you dislike the game. We saw that some people gave us a negative review. We consider it an opportunity to fix the things they mentioned and are grateful for their feedback. In the meantime, [b]we are working hard on the first fix [/b]that we announced yesterday.

Thanks again, [b]we appreciate everyone that has already given a feedback [/b]and we are looking forward to anything you will comment here. Until next time Hunters!

DRAGO Entertainment & Movie Games Teams

notes.title: Treasure Hunter Simulator has launched
notes.notes:
Fellow Treasure Hunters,

The wait is almost over! Thanks for your patience and your continuous support! 

We’ve used the last couple of weeks to polish a lot of elements of our game so that you could enjoy your adventures to the fullest. [b]Let’s celebrate it with finding some treasures[/b], shall we?

Are you prepared? Does the metal detector have a full battery? Are your old, comfy shoes ready and polished? Is the canteen full of water? Is the backpack empty and waiting for goodies? Just don’t forget a hat and some tanning oil, so that you won’t get sunburned. 

As you may remember, we promised additional languages for the release. English, Spanish, German, Russian, French, Italian, Turkish, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Polish are there! [b]We are also happy to announce that we managed to add Portuguese to the list[/b]!

That’s not all! To celebrate the premiere even louder, [b]we discounted the game for 15% [/b]as a reward for you to compensate for the postponed release date. So if you don’t own the game yet, it’s the best time to grab it for a bit less. 

We are adding last details, and as soon we are ready, we will make the game live! 

Kind regards,

DRAGO Entertainment & Movie Games Teams

notes.title: Change of the release date and additional translations
notes.notes:
Fellow Treasure Hunters,

We know you have your backpacks packed and metal detectors up and ready, but we would like to ask you to hold the rush for treasures for just a little bit longer.

Today we supposed to release Treasure Hunter Simulator, but we are not able to do it.

Here’s the reason: we want Treasure Hunter Simulator to be the game you can enjoy and relax playing, but also a game in which you can get to know interesting information and historical facts. In order to provide both, we want to offer you the game in as many languages as possible.

As our game includes lots of facts, anecdotes and information about all the items and treasures you can find, our translators are really working tirelessly to translate it accurately, and they just need a little bit more time.

Therefore, please keep your enthusiasm and stay with us for a little bit longer, in return we promise to bring Treasure Hunter Simulator on your PCs in the following languages:

notes.title: Treasure Hunter Beta Build 3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]In order to avoid any issues with previous saves we ask everyone to start a new game once the patch is applied.[/b]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Survey
[list]
[*]A survey button has been added to the lower right corner of the screen when in the main menu that will direct you to a questionnaire with specific questions to some aspects of the game. Those questionnaires will all be manually reviewed and used for making decisions about upcoming changes to game.
[/list]
[*]Money
[list]
[*]Cash has returned to Treasure Hunter.
[*]Cash rather than Prestige is now awarded when selling items.
[*]Trash items are automatically sold (they also no longer require an identification).
[/list]
[*]Prestige
[list]
[*]Prestige is now awarded upon picking up an item (value based on the rarity).
[/list]
[*]Metal Detectors
[list]
[*]Prestige is required to unlock detectors.
[*]Cash is spent to actually buy them once unlocked via Prestige.
[/list]
[*]Jobs
[list]
[*]Many jobs have been updated to use more engaging mechanics.
[*]The beta now gives access to 3 main story jobs and 6 side jobs.
[*]New job type: Photo job – take a photograph using the in-game camera of a specific area and/or object in the world.
[*]New job type: Trail job – create a trail between point A and B within a time limit.
[*]Jobs with multiple objectives now save their progress.
[/list]
[*]World Map
[list]
[*]Multiple pins have been moved slightly to better correspond to their world locations.
[*]Traveling to locations other than the Bavarian Lake now costs money.
[*]Each location now shows a small legend with percentage values for each type of treasure that can be found in that location.
[/list]
[*]Treasures
[list]
[*]The treasures are now much more randomized and have a much higher pool.
[*]The chance to find a trash item instead of a treasure has been tweaked.
[*]A lot of missing descriptions have been added.
[/list]
[*]Other
[list]
[*]Keybindings are now working correctly again.
[*]A new "Unstuck" button has been added in the in-world menu in case you should get stuck.
[*]All detectors should get stuck under the ground less often.
[/list]
[/olist]

notes.title: Treasure Hunter Beta Build 2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Due to the number of changes we had to change the save system. This means that your current saves will not work correctly. Please start a new game.[/b]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]
[olist]
[*]A new e-mail system has been implemented that allows you to receive email with tasks/jobs.
[list]
[*]There are three types of e-mails: Special, Jobs and Side Jobs
[*]Important e-mails explain the storyline based on the players progression
[*]Jobs offer storyline important quests
[*]Side jobs offer a quick way to earn some additional Prestige Points
[*]Jobs and Side jobs can offer detectors as a reward
[/list]
[*]A camera has been implemented
[list]
[*]You can now use the in-game camera to take screenshots without the HUD getting in the way. In the future we intend to use the camera for jobs as well.
[*]Currently the screenshots are saved in "C:\Users\"USER_NAME"\AppData\Local\TH\Saved\Screenshots"
[/list]
[*]A PDA has been implemented
[list]
[*]The PDA can be accessed while adventuring
[*]The map, accepted jobs list (of this specific map) and camera can be accessed through the PDA
[/list]
[*]The map has been improved
[list]
[*]You can now see the path you took on the map
[*]All dug up items have been marked on the map
[/list]
[*]Exploration has been improved
[list]
[*]You can now walk freely while the detector is working in the background looking for treasures
[*]When getting near a treasure the detector will create a beeping noise and will allow you to switch to the "Precise search" mode.
[*]The "Precise search" mode works like previously
[/list]
[*]A work-in-progress visual indicator for treasures has been implemented
[*]Maps have been optimized further to decrease possible FPS drops
[*]Tracks have been marked on the maps to make orientation easier
[*]The Auction House has been removed
[list]
[*]Selling items now happens instantly from the "Collection" menu
[/list]
[*]All references to money have been removed.
[list]
[*]Detectors can no longer be bought using money
[*]Identification cost has been removed
[*]Sold items now award Prestige Points
[/list]
[*]Existing items descriptions have been reworked and more item descriptions added. This is an ongoing process.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Exceptional items can now be sold
[*]The transparent terrain issue in the Bavarian Lake map has been fixed
[*]Rotating the treasure while identifying has been improved
[*]The in-office map has been improved for all aspect ratios
[*]The digging sound is now correctly respecting the game sound settings
[/list]
